targetText: Unfortunately it is still true to say of many of our comrades, 'scratch a communist and find a philistine'. 0f course, you must scratch the sensitive spot, their mentality as regards women. Could there be a more damning proof of this than the calm acquiescence of men who see how women grow worn out In petty, monotonous household work, their strength and time dissipated and wasted, their minds growing narrow and stale, their hearts beating slowly, their will weakened!
summary: "Scratch a communist and find a philistine": Lenin condemns male comrades who tolerate women's domestic drudgery at home.
explanation: Lenin exposes how patriarchal habits persist even among professed revolutionaries who treat women's political organization as secondary and refuse to share domestic burdens.

targetText: Our communist work among the women, our political work, embraces a great deal of educational work among men. We must root out the old 'master' idea to its last and smallest root, in the Party and among the masses.
summary: Women's emancipation requires systematic ideological struggle to uproot patriarchal "master" privilege among working-class men.
explanation: Lenin insists that communist work on the woman question is never just "women's work": the Party must actively re-educate male workers to abandon domestic privilege and treat women as equal comrades.
